notes.content:
Gensou Skydrift - Wild West 2
Hosted by the Unofficial Gensou Skydrift Community Discord

https://docs.google.com/document/d/10tddhs0FUxAqyuZmaiS8oEg3X8oyemAzm1n17BGvFQM/edit

“Registration
Entry into the tournament is FREE!

Open to any & all players, regardless of region.

To register, join the Unofficial Gensou Skydrift Community Discord (https://discord.gg/gsSdsTG) and write your entry in the ‘Tournament Registration’ channel. Please see the example below.

Name: C-MASTER
Character: Cirno / Reimu
User ID: C1RN0X
Comment: Cirno is the strongest!!

Character selection throughout the tournament is locked. You may change which characters you wish to play with by editing your entry before the tournament deadline.

NOTE: USER ID can be found in the CONFIG menu in game.

notes.title: 2.062 Update
notes.content:
- Even if you have accumulated LW, you can now play LV2 spells if you hold down the spell button.
- The crash time of a hit is now slightly shorter as the character's MASS value increases.
　* Along with this, we asked Suika to lose some weight. (MASS ↓↓↓)
- The spell card table immediately after the start of the race has been changed.
- Increased the sensitivity of ascending and descending through the air when using the controller on the Switch version.
- Fixed a bug that prevented pausing during LW of Sakiya.
- Fixed an issue where replays were not saved correctly in Spectator Mode.
- Some of the courses have been adjusted.
- You can now wait for other players longer when connecting to a rank match (2.061).

notes.title: 2.052 Update
notes.content:
- Change the sensitivity of the keyboard's elevation and descent input.
- Fixed a bug that caused the ranking to change unnecessarily during a race.
- The previous season's top rankers have their names colored in the lobby.

notes.title: 2.050 Update
notes.content:
- The character performance has been changed.
　- LW performance of Suwako / Sakuya / Koishi has been increased. Koishi's LW now increases the LW gauge as well.
　- Flandre BOOST↑
- The READY sticker will now appear when the switch button is pressed in the network room.
　- Test function. There may be more stickers.
- Some costume colors have been added.

notes.title: 2.030 Update
notes.content:
- You can now see "Time attack ranking by character" on the race record website.
- Fixing the problem that the shape of the radar chart was not displayed correctly.
  * Also fixed a bug where GRIP (non-slip) of character parameters was not reflected correctly.
- While holding "Light Trap of Passing Away" it was no longer drowned out by other spellings.
- "Spiritual Strike" has an effect to erase other part of spelling as per manual.
- Adjusted the winning judgment for several courses.
- Adjusted the exit behavior during online matches.
- Adjusted the behavior of "Attack of the Scary Blue UFOs".
- The Switch now allows you to record offline time attacks and send them later.

notes.title: 2.020 Update
notes.content:
・The character's performance/LW retention has been changed.
　- Reimu: SPELL↑ / LW↑↑
　- Marisa: SPEED↑
　- Sakuya: BOOST ↑↑ / LW↑↑
　- Sanae: BOOST↑ / LW↑
　- Suwako: LW↑
　- Koishi: DRIFT↑↑
　- Futo: AIR↑ / DRIFT↑
　- Yukari: LW↑↑
・We can adjust the character performance and the ease of accumulation of LW at any time through server setting. We will notify you when there is a change.
・Fixed the problem of stopping when selecting metal color.
・Adjusted wall judgment and UFO behavior in some courses.

notes.title: 2.014 Update
notes.content:
(We decided to write the client version as the title.)

- Some of network timeout issues are fixed.
* But some cases are still remained. Please let us know if your client experiences frequent timeout. (Send us a log through DEV Discord)

notes.title: 05/Jan Update
notes.content:
- Udonge's LW is automatically activated when it is hit.
- Fixed an Infrequently Strange Finish Ranking Problem
- Fixed the Problem that No Falling Bonus in the Deepest Part of -Underground City
- Fixed an issue in which the Perfect Freeze did not work in some cases.
- Course fix: Sea of Tranquility / Youkai Mountain / Voile Library
- Fix problem that random setting of the ending character causes trouble at next load.
- Fixed a problem that class was not immediately reflected on the room screen
- Fixed 3P Multimode problem

notes.title: 12/26 Update!
notes.content:
It became Ver 2.012!

- The race record site has opened. You can open it from the in-game config.
- Now you can use the keyboard to configure keys (When you have no controller connection on your PC).
- Adjusted Sea of Tranquility.
- Spell card graphics for 3x Onmyoufuda and 3x magical mushroom bombs have been modified.
- Replaying time attacks now has time.
- Other minor bug fixes.

*If there is anything that affects the balance, such as the adjustment of the LW charge speed, it will be updated at the same time as the Switch version.

notes.title: 12/20 Patch
notes.content:
Small patch for bug fix
- Resolution config problem
- Pause during race
- Maricircuit2 invisible wall

notes.title: 12/19 Update
notes.content:
Version 2.010 has been restored. (Same as Switch version)

*Fixed the course collision rarely goes wrong in free run.
*Some part of "Underworld City Depths" have been modified. This prevents previous replays from being used.
*Fixed the defect that some characters' LW gauges were easy to increase.
*Flan's / Futo's LW gauge is now charged more quickly.

Note that with this update, the network will no longer be connected to the previous version of the client.

notes.title: 12/16 Bugfix Update
notes.content:
GENSOU Skydrift Version 2.001 is released!

*You can now choose which network regions you want to join from the configuration. Now you can play with distant friends!
*Key configuration now supports special buttons like XBOX controller triggers.
*Fixed bugs around config.
*I corrected the mistakes around translation.
*Now you can play in offline mode only.
*Fixed a problem in class notation after playing rank matches.
*Other minor defects have been fixed.
